title: GRC Manager / Information Security Manager
summary: A GRC manager (governance, risk and compliance) runs a company's information security programme: its policies, risk process, audits and certifications. It is a senior role that leads analysts and auditors and reports security risk to leadership and the board.
dailyDuties: Own the ISMS (information security management system) and policy set
Run certification programmes such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS
Face external auditors and regulators such as RBI, SEBI and IRDAI
Run the enterprise risk process and agree risk treatment with business heads
Run the vendor risk programme and BCP/DR tests
Coordinate DPDP Act compliance with legal
Lead a team of analysts and present risk posture to leadership

skills.expectation: Own certification programmes such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS
Run the enterprise security risk process and report to the board
Own the ISMS and the policy set
Face external auditors and regulators (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI)
Coordinate DPDP Act compliance with legal
Lead a team of analysts and auditors
Agree risk treatment with business heads

certifications.why: Proves audit depth and 5 years of experience
Security management with 5 years of experience
